content_sections.heading: NIT Tiruchirappalli Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NIT Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NIT Tiruchirappalli Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NIT Tiruchirappalli Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Associate and 1 for Project Assistant.

content_sections.heading: NIT Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Associate: M.E./ M.Tech./ M.Plan/ Other Appropriate Relevant Degrees in Civil Engineering or equivalent or B.E./ B.Tech./ B.Arch/ B.Plan/ Other Appropriate Relevant Degrees in Civil Engineering or equivalent. Project Assistant: 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology or a relevant Degree with First Class in Civil Engineering or an equivalent qualification.

content_sections.heading: NIT Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts. Age Relaxation: SC/ ST - 5 years, OBC - 3 years. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.text: Project Associate: Rs. 25000/ - per month Project Assistant: Rs. 18000/ - per month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Tiruchirappalli to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Tiruchirappalli recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Project Associate & Project Assistant posts is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate & Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Associate and Project Assistant positions in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Associate?
faq.answer: For the Project Associate position, candidates need to have an M.E./M.Tech./M.Plan or equivalent in Civil Engineering, or a B.E./B.Tech./B.Arch/B.Plan or equivalent in Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate & Project Assistant posts will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Project Associate and Project Assistant are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of NIT Tiruchirappalli?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli is located in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 620015.
